spans.s:
mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Many, much, not one.
E.
अन् neg. एक one.

adv. n. (-लं)
A long time.
E.
अनेक, and काल time.

m. (-जः)
A bird, born more than once; or in the shell, and upon being hatched.
E.
अनेक more than one, and ज what is born.

f. (-ता)
Muchness, manifold condition; also अनेकत्वं.
E.
अनेक, and ता or त्व aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Multiform.
E.
अनेक and आकार form.

mfn. (-पः-पा)
An elephant.
E.
अनेक various, from अन् neg. एक one, and प from पा who drinks, who drinks with his trunk, and with his mouth.

Of various kinds or sorts.
3 Fickle, of variable mind.
E.
अनेक, and रूप form.

mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
Various, of many kinds, in different ways.
E.
अनेक, and विध sort.

ind.
By large numbers or quantities.
E.
अनेक, and शसि aff.

ind.
In various ways.
E.
अनेक and धाच् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Deaf and dumb.
2 Wicked, fraudulent.
E.
अन् here implying similarity, ण्ड deaf, and मूक dumb. See एडमूक.

mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः)
Blameless, sinless.
E.
अन् neg. एनस् fault.

ind.
Otherwise, or.
E.
अन् neg. एव so.

m. (-हाः)
Time.
E.
अन् neg. हन to kill or hurt, एहच् substitute, and असि Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be brought or taken.
E.
आङ् before णी to take, तव्य aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be taken or brought.
E.
आङ् before णी to take, ण्यत् aff.
